item.title: Nigeria announces rescue of 308 kidnapped citizens

item.title: FIFA pledges to defend Infantino after World Cup rights plan collapses
item.description: Infantino has faced leadership crisis as UEFA, AFC and Concacaf threaten drastic actions over commercial rights plan.

item.title: Erica Schwartz confirmed as new CDC chief amid US agency turmoil
item.description: US public health agency faces toughest test as Schwartz takes charge amid political pressure and public health crises.

item.description: Israeli occupation destroys farmland and lives in southern Syria

item.title: US officials push back on reports of dangerously low munitions supplies
item.description: Experts warn that low stockpiles of air defence interceptors as a result of the war on Iran leave the US vulnerable.

item.title: US man arrested at Trump’s golf course charged with multiple felonies
item.description: Ex-Marine denies charges after arrest at Los Angeles golf course, with weapons, badge and 'concerning' notebooks found.

item.title: Israeli forces raid camp in occupied West Bank
item.description: Israeli forces have launched a large-scale military operation in Qalandiya refugee camp in the occupied West Bank.

item.description: Pakistan police fired tear gas at supporters of jailed former Prime Minister Imran Khan in Rawalpindi.

item.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary
item.description: Abdul el-Sayed has won Michigan’s Democratic senate primary

item.title: US announces more than $100m in rewards for eight Jalisco cartel leaders
item.description: The Trump administration has sought to weaken the leadership of high-profile Mexican cartels by increasing the bounties.

item.title: Iran says Hormuz talks with Oman in ‘final’ stages as route approved
item.description: The geographical coordinates of the route in the waterway have been agreed upon with Oman, according to Tehran.

item.title: What’s behind US Representative Massie’s claims over crisis at Ceuta?
item.description: Figures like Representative Thomas Massie have questioned whether crisis is related to US support for Morocco.

item.title: SpaceX shares slide on the heels of first quarterly report
item.description: The stock was down more than 13 percent as investors were spooked by the company's heavy investments.

item.description: Deposed Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina says she will return in December.

item.title: New Mexico sues US Justice Department for impeding Epstein probe
item.description: The southwestern US state's attorney general argues that the federal government is withholding key unredacted documents.

item.title: Young pilot makes daring emergency landing on Florida interstate
item.description: A 21-year-old flight instructor safely landed her small aircraft on a US freeway near Pensacola, Florida.

item.title: Brazil’s Flavio Bolsonaro names Alfredo Gaspar as running mate
item.description: The announcement comes as Lula warns of foreign interference and polls show a tightening presidential race.

item.title: Malaysia vows not to return Rohingya refugees to Myanmar if lives at risk
item.description: Authorities are screening 5,000 refugees as rights groups warn they remain at risk of persecution in Myanmar.

item.title: US authorities say three killed in Prospect Hill, North Carolina shooting
item.description: Law enforcement says at least three people were killed in shooting at a home, with those involved part of same family.

item.title: Is the conflict between Russia and Ukraine deepening?
item.description: The war sees a surge in attacks by both sides with little diplomatic movement.

item.title: Photos: Israeli forces raid occupied West Bank’s Qalandiya refugee camp
item.description: Eight Palestinian people injured after Israeli forces enter homes, shops in Qalandiya, issuing demolition threats.

item.title: El-Sayed wins Michigan Democratic Senate primary
item.description: Abdul El-Sayed won Michigan's Democratic primary for US Senate, narrowly defeating Rep. Haley Stevens.

item.title: Puntland forces seize government-held camp in Somalia’s Galkayo
item.description: Puntland says it has taken control of Galkayo camp as rival federal-aligned forces retreat following intense clashes.

item.title: At least one Lebanese person, two Israeli soldiers killed in south Lebanon
item.description: The violence comes amid talks between Lebanon and Israel as Beirut pushes for a phased Israeli troop withdrawal.

item.title: LIV Golf secures ‘lead’ investor for player-driven future after Saudi exit
item.description: An agreement with an unnamed investor is approved by the LIV Golf board to replace Saudi Arabia deal.
